items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: he was here at the -- with Bill Rinehart at the Jazz Limited.

ctx.x: That's right, they came up here in the winter.

Right, and do they would come over and they would come to the breakfast shows and all of that. And then this is when I really met and got close with Jo Jones, because Jo -- I don't know, he took a liking to me and he used to come around all the time. So did Sid, the last days, when he -- well, we had been friends down through the years, but not where he was always like in New York or somewhere like that. And then the last years -- I mean, the last year or two, he was here at the -- with Bill Rinehart at the Jazz…
And we were really close then. And he lived in one of my sister's buildings. He had a room there.
